test_cases.summary:
Verify generated user name/details match stored value
when a version was generated by User A
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Metadata – Generated User Accuracy

Scenario: Verify generated user name/details match stored value

Given a version was generated by User A
When the Version History list is displayed
Then the Generated User details should display User A correctly as stored
test_cases.acceptance:
The Generated User details should display User A correctly as stored
The behavior should be validated when the Version History list is displayed.

test_cases.summary:
Verify metadata is displayed without changes or reformatting
when stored metadata contains specific formatting (ex: date format, username format)
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Metadata – No Format Modification

Scenario: Verify metadata is displayed without changes or reformatting

Given stored metadata contains specific formatting (ex: date format, username format)
When the UI binds metadata to Version History table
Then metadata should be displayed exactly as stored without modification
test_cases.acceptance:
Metadata should be displayed exactly as stored without modification
The behavior should be validated when the UI binds metadata to Version History table.

test_cases.summary:
Verify metadata values remain correct after refresh/relogin
when version history is displayed with metadata values
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Metadata – Metadata Persists After Refresh

Scenario: Verify metadata values remain correct after refresh/relogin

Given version history is displayed with metadata values
When the user refreshes the page or logs out and logs in again
Then the metadata should remain accurate and unchanged
test_cases.acceptance:
The metadata should remain accurate and unchanged
The behavior should be validated when the user refreshes the page or logs out and logs in again.

test_cases.summary:
Verify metadata helps differentiate versions correctly
when multiple versions exist with different timestamps and generated users
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Metadata – Multiple Versions Differentiation

Scenario: Verify metadata helps differentiate versions correctly

Given multiple versions exist with different timestamps and generated users
When the Version History list is displayed
Then each version should show correct unique metadata values per record
test_cases.acceptance:
Each version should show correct unique metadata values per record
The behavior should be validated when the Version History list is displayed.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Version History panel is available for the selected session
when the user opened a session that supports JSON versions
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version History – Panel Visibility

Scenario: Verify Version History panel is available for the selected session

Given the user opened a session that supports JSON versions
When the user navigates to Version Tracker / Version History panel
Then the Version History panel should be displayed
test_cases.acceptance:
The Version History panel should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when the user navigates to Version Tracker / Version History panel.

test_cases.summary:
Verify system retrieves all versions for selected session only
when Session A and Session B exist with different version histories
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version History – Fetch Versions for Selected Session

Scenario: Verify system retrieves all versions for selected session only

Given Session A and Session B exist with different version histories
When the user opens Version History for Session A
Then the system should retrieve and display only Session A versions
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should retrieve and display only Session A versions
The behavior should be validated when the user opens Version History for Session A.

test_cases.summary:
Verify versions are displayed in structured list/table format
when multiple versions exist for the session
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version History – Display Versions in Structured Table

Scenario: Verify versions are displayed in structured list/table format

Given multiple versions exist for the session
When Version History panel loads
Then versions should be displayed in a structured list/table view
test_cases.acceptance:
Versions should be displayed in a structured list/table view
The behavior should be validated when Version History panel loads.

test_cases.summary:
Verify all stored versions are displayed in history panel
when the session contains versions V1 to V10 in storage
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version History – All Versions Loaded

Scenario: Verify all stored versions are displayed in history panel

Given the session contains versions V1 to V10 in storage
When the Version History panel loads
Then the UI should display all versions from V1 to V10
test_cases.acceptance:
The UI should display all versions from V1 to V10
The behavior should be validated when the Version History panel loads.

test_cases.summary:
Verify versions are displayed in correct order
when multiple versions exist with sequential numbering
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version History – Order of Versions

Scenario: Verify versions are displayed in correct order

Given multiple versions exist with sequential numbering
When Version History panel is displayed
Then versions should be listed in correct order (latest first or oldest first as per system design)
test_cases.acceptance:
Versions should be listed in correct order (latest first or oldest first as per system design)
The behavior should be validated when Version History panel is displayed.

test_cases.summary:
Verify empty state shown when no versions exist
when the selected session has no JSON versions generated yet
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version History – No Versions Handling

Scenario: Verify empty state shown when no versions exist

Given the selected session has no JSON versions generated yet
When the user opens Version History panel
Then the system should show an empty state message (ex: “No versions available”)
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should show an empty state message (ex: "No versions available")
The behavior should be validated when the user opens Version History panel.

test_cases.summary:
Verify newly created versions appear after refresh/open
when the user opened Version History panel
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version History – Refresh Panel Loads Latest Data

Scenario: Verify newly created versions appear after refresh/open

Given the user opened Version History panel
When the user generates a new JSON version
And reopens or refreshes Version History panel
Then the newly created version should appear in the list
test_cases.acceptance:
The newly created version should appear in the list
The behavior should be validated when the user generates a new JSON version.

test_cases.summary:
Verify retrieved version metadata binds correctly to UI
when version records exist with stored version number, date/time, and generated user
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version History – Metadata Binding

Scenario: Verify retrieved version metadata binds correctly to UI

Given version records exist with stored version number, date/time, and generated user
When Version History panel loads
Then the UI should bind and display metadata correctly for each version row
test_cases.acceptance:
The UI should bind and display metadata correctly for each version row
The behavior should be validated when Version History panel loads.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Download button is available for each version row
when Version History list contains multiple versions
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Download – Download Action per Row

Scenario: Verify Download button is available for each version row

Given Version History list contains multiple versions
When the user views the version table
Then Download action/button should be available for each version row
test_cases.acceptance:
Download action/button should be available for each version row
The behavior should be validated when the user views the version table.

test_cases.summary:
Verify user can select a version row for download
when Version History list is displayed
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Download – Select Version Row

Scenario: Verify user can select a version row for download

Given Version History list is displayed
When the user selects a specific version row (ex: V3)
Then the selected row should become active and ready for download
test_cases.acceptance:
The selected row should become active and ready for download
The behavior should be validated when the user selects a specific version row (ex: V3).

test_cases.summary:
Verify system downloads selected JSON version successfully
when the user selected version V4 in Version History list
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Download – Download Selected Version Successfully

Scenario: Verify system downloads selected JSON version successfully

Given the user selected version V4 in Version History list
When the user clicks Download action
Then the system should retrieve V4 JSON file from storage
And start secure file download
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should retrieve V4 JSON file from storage
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks Download action.

test_cases.summary:
Verify downloaded file matches selected version content
when V1 and V2 have different JSON content
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Download – Correct File Content Validation

Scenario: Verify downloaded file matches selected version content

Given V1 and V2 have different JSON content
When the user downloads V2
Then the downloaded JSON should match V2 stored data and not V1
test_cases.acceptance:
The downloaded JSON should match V2 stored data and not V1
The behavior should be validated when the user downloads V2.

test_cases.summary:
Verify user can download different versions one by one
when multiple versions exist in Version History list
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Download – Multiple Version Downloads

Scenario: Verify user can download different versions one by one

Given multiple versions exist in Version History list
When the user downloads V2 and then downloads V5
Then both downloads should work correctly without conflict
test_cases.acceptance:
Both downloads should work correctly without conflict
The behavior should be validated when the user downloads V2 and then downloads V5.

test_cases.summary:
Verify user-friendly message shown if file is unavailable
when a version row exists but the file is missing in storage
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Download – File Missing Error Handling

Scenario: Verify user-friendly message shown if file is unavailable

Given a version row exists but the file is missing in storage
When the user clicks Download
Then the system should show a user-friendly error notification
And should not expose technical error details
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should show a user-friendly error notification
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks Download.

test_cases.summary:
Verify safe error shown if retrieval fails due to network/server issue
when the system cannot retrieve version file due to backend failure
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Download – Retrieval Failure Handling

Scenario: Verify safe error shown if retrieval fails due to network/server issue

Given the system cannot retrieve version file due to backend failure
When the user clicks Download for a selected version
Then the system should show user-friendly error notification
And download should not start
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should show user-friendly error notification
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks Download for a selected version.

test_cases.summary:
Verify system does not expose technical error messages to user
when a download fails due to any issue
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Download – No Technical Error Leakage

Scenario: Verify system does not expose technical error messages to user

Given a download fails due to any issue
When the error message is displayed
Then the message should be user-friendly
And should not contain stack traces, API URLs, or system error codes
test_cases.acceptance:
The message should be user-friendly
The behavior should be validated when the error message is displayed.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Version History table displays metadata columns
when version history contains JSON versions
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Metadata – Metadata Columns Displayed

Scenario: Verify Version History table displays metadata columns

Given version history contains JSON versions
When the user opens Version History list
Then Version Number, Generated Date & Time, and Generated By columns should be displayed
test_cases.acceptance:
Version Number, Generated Date & Time, and Generated By columns should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when the user opens Version History list.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Version Number column is populated for each record
when multiple versions exist in history
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Metadata – Version Number Populated

Scenario: Verify Version Number column is populated for each record

Given multiple versions exist in history
When the table loads
Then each version row should display a valid version number
test_cases.acceptance:
Each version row should display a valid version number
The behavior should be validated when the table loads.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Generated Date & Time is displayed for each version
when versions exist with stored timestamps
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Metadata – Generated Date & Time Populated

Scenario: Verify Generated Date & Time is displayed for each version

Given versions exist with stored timestamps
When the Version History list loads
Then each version row should show Generated Date & Time correctly
test_cases.acceptance:
Each version row should show Generated Date & Time correctly
The behavior should be validated when the Version History list loads.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Generated By column shows correct user name
when versions were created by different users
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Metadata – Generated By Populated

Scenario: Verify Generated By column shows correct user name

Given versions were created by different users
When the Version History list loads
Then each version row should display the correct Generated By user name
test_cases.acceptance:
Each version row should display the correct Generated By user name
The behavior should be validated when the Version History list loads.

test_cases.summary:
Verify metadata helps distinguish versions clearly
when multiple versions exist (V1, V2, V3)
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Metadata – Traceability Across Versions

Scenario: Verify metadata helps distinguish versions clearly

Given multiple versions exist (V1, V2, V3)
When the user compares metadata across rows
Then each version should be uniquely identifiable using version number + date/time + generated by
test_cases.acceptance:
Each version should be uniquely identifiable using version number + date/time + generated by
The behavior should be validated when the user compares metadata across rows.

test_cases.summary:
Verify default value shown if metadata is unavailable
when a version record exists with missing metadata field (ex: Generated By is null)
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Metadata – Missing Metadata Shows N/A

Scenario: Verify default value shown if metadata is unavailable

Given a version record exists with missing metadata field (ex: Generated By is null)
When the Version History list loads
Then the missing metadata field should display “N/A”
And UI should not break
test_cases.acceptance:
The missing metadata field should display "N/A"
The behavior should be validated when the Version History list loads.

test_cases.summary:
Verify table renders correctly even if metadata missing for multiple records
when multiple version records exist with missing metadata values
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Metadata – UI Stability With Missing Metadata

Scenario: Verify table renders correctly even if metadata missing for multiple records

Given multiple version records exist with missing metadata values
When the Version History table loads
Then the table should render without crash or alignment issues
test_cases.acceptance:
The table should render without crash or alignment issues
The behavior should be validated when the Version History table loads.

test_cases.summary:
Verify metadata loads correctly after refresh/reopen
when Version History table shows metadata values
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Metadata – Metadata Binding on Refresh

Scenario: Verify metadata loads correctly after refresh/reopen

Given Version History table shows metadata values
When the user refreshes the page or reopens Version History panel
Then the metadata values should load correctly again
test_cases.acceptance:
The metadata values should load correctly again
The behavior should be validated when the user refreshes the page or reopens Version History panel.

test_cases.summary:
Verify user can view version history list before downloading a JSON file
when the user opens Version Tracker for a session
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version History – List Visible Before Download

Scenario: Verify user can view version history list before downloading a JSON file

Given the user opens Version Tracker for a session
When the Version History panel/modal loads
Then the list of previously generated/downloaded versions should be displayed
test_cases.acceptance:
The list of previously generated/downloaded versions should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when the Version History panel/modal loads.

test_cases.summary:
Verify version history shows version number, file name, date/time, and download action
when versions exist for the session
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version History – Display Required Columns

Scenario: Verify version history shows version number, file name, date/time, and download action

Given versions exist for the session
When the version history table is displayed
Then Version Number, File Name, Date/Time, and Download action should be shown for each entry
test_cases.acceptance:
Version Number, File Name, Date/Time, and Download action should be shown for each entry
The behavior should be validated when the version history table is displayed.

test_cases.summary:
Verify all generated versions appear in history list
when the session contains versions V1 to V6
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version History – Display All Previously Generated Versions

Scenario: Verify all generated versions appear in history list

Given the session contains versions V1 to V6
When the version history loads
Then all versions V1 to V6 should appear in the list
test_cases.acceptance:
All versions V1 to V6 should appear in the list
The behavior should be validated when the version history loads.

test_cases.summary:
Verify previously downloaded versions remain visible in history list
when the user downloaded version V2 earlier
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version History – Display Downloaded Versions in History

Scenario: Verify previously downloaded versions remain visible in history list

Given the user downloaded version V2 earlier
When the user reopens the version history list
Then V2 should still be visible in the list
test_cases.acceptance:
V2 should still be visible in the list
The behavior should be validated when the user reopens the version history list.

test_cases.summary:
Verify list loads dynamically when panel/modal is opened
when versions exist in storage
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version History – Dynamic Load on Panel Open

Scenario: Verify list loads dynamically when panel/modal is opened

Given versions exist in storage
When the user opens Version History panel/modal
Then the system should fetch metadata and populate the list dynamically
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should fetch metadata and populate the list dynamically
The behavior should be validated when the user opens Version History panel/modal.

test_cases.summary:
Verify "No versions available" message shown when no versions exist
when the selected session has no versions generated/downloaded
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version History – Empty State Handling

Scenario: Verify “No versions available” message shown when no versions exist

Given the selected session has no versions generated/downloaded
When the user opens Version History list
Then the system should display “No versions available” message
And should not show any system errors
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should display "No versions available" message
The behavior should be validated when the user opens Version History list.

test_cases.summary:
Verify newly created version appears immediately in history list
when the user has version history open
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version History – List Refresh After New Version Created

Scenario: Verify newly created version appears immediately in history list

Given the user has version history open
When the user generates a new JSON version
And refreshes/reopens the history list
Then the new version should appear in the list
test_cases.acceptance:
The new version should appear in the list
The behavior should be validated when the user generates a new JSON version.

test_cases.summary:
Verify user can download a previous version from the list
when the version history list is displayed
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version History – Download Action Works from History List

Scenario: Verify user can download a previous version from the list

Given the version history list is displayed
When the user clicks Download for any previous version
Then the system should download the correct selected version successfully
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should download the correct selected version successfully
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks Download for any previous version.

test_cases.summary:
Verify version history loads quickly with small dataset
when a session has less than 10 versions stored
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version History – Fast Load for Small Dataset

Scenario: Verify version history loads quickly with small dataset

Given a session has less than 10 versions stored
When the user opens the Version History panel
Then the version list should load quickly without noticeable delay
test_cases.acceptance:
The version list should load quickly without noticeable delay
The behavior should be validated when the user opens the Version History panel.
